critical_code_review_comments: /app/mobile/app/(tabs)/realm/my-shop.tsx delete-confirm Modal buttons had no testID; addressed in this iteration.

PUT /api/items/{item_id} requires the full ItemCreate body (name/description/category/etc.). This is a partial-update anti-pattern — clients must round-trip every field to change a single one. Consider accepting a partial update model.
